name: Ω-DISCOVERY-KERNEL-T∞ million-scale forced-resume frontier
status: OAKBench finite experiment, not a permanent architecture ceiling

storage.event_representation: one compact JSON array per event
storage.integrity: per-event SHA-256 plus chained ledger digest
storage.rollback: delete generated frontier directory after hash and provenance review

forced_interruption.negative_memory_rule: Never infer resumability from a clean uninterrupted run.
forced_interruption.redesign: Force termination, checkpoint, resume, reject duplicates and verify digest continuity.

sqlite_batch_latency.negative_memory_rule: Never increase index complexity without measuring commit latency.
sqlite_batch_latency.redesign: Repartition indexes, reduce batch size or separate cold lineage storage.

resident_memory.negative_memory_rule: Never exchange unbounded RAM growth for throughput.
resident_memory.redesign: Reduce cache and in-process state while preserving disk-backed indexes.

disk_backpressure.negative_memory_rule: Never continue when rollback storage cannot be guaranteed.
disk_backpressure.redesign: Pause, checkpoint, expand or compact storage, then resume.

prohibited_inferences: One million valid records prove a scientific claim.
A completed synthetic frontier proves external reproducibility.
Passing CI authorizes physical, financial, legal, publication or deployment actions.
next_frontiers: Measure the actual saturation curve across 1M, 2M, 5M and 10M finite workloads.
Partition lineage and subject indexes when SQLite latency becomes dominant.
Add content-addressed external dataset locators and real held-out scientific results.
Run independent replication on a second compute environment.
Generate M-minus rules from every observed resource or quality saturation.
